name: forager
description: Forager: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes across free LLM tiers on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy:fora: wrangler deploy --domain fora.ger.soy --var GITHUB_REPO:volkanger/forager --var GITHUB_POLL:2 --var CHAT_HISTORY:1 --var CACHED_TOKENS_FREE:zhipu

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Optional. Name of a Cloudflare AI Gateway to log requests through. If it doesn't exist, Forager calls providers directly.

TRACKER.description: Durable Object that tracks free-quota usage per cycle and stores encrypted provider keys.

AI.description: Workers AI binding, used only to find your account ID for AI Gateway URLs.
